result:
If I could change one thing, I would make it so that every person, without exception, could experience one moment of genuine, unguarded connection with another—human, animal, or even the quiet of a landscape—early enough in life that it becomes the baseline they measure everything else against.

Not wealth, not intelligence, not power—just the felt, bodily certainty that they are not alone in the world, and that reality is worth paying attention to. Everything else—empathy, curiosity, the courage to build, the patience to repair—seems to grow out of that root.
